integrity: The arXiv record verifies first posting on 2026-09-27 and primary MSC 03E15. The full source text was inspected at the percolation quotient construction, quotient labelling correspondence, amenability-to-hyperfiniteness step, planarity inheritance, and measurable five-color theorem. The sixth-color extension was reconstructed directly from the measurable invariant event of belonging to the unique infinite cluster.
scientific_limitations: The theorem gives upper bounds only. The six-color argument assumes a unique infinite percolation component and does not treat phases with infinitely many infinite clusters. It is formulated in the transitive unimodular factor-of-iid framework of the source.
title: Five colors below percolation and six in the uniqueness phase for planar amenable quotients
